descriptionChirho: To apply oil, ointment, or perfume to a person's body, head, or feet; used of anointing for hospitality (Luke 7:38,46), devotion (John 11:2; 12:3), healing (Mark 6:13; Jas 5:14), burial preparation (Mark 16:1), and personal grooming while fasting (Matt 6:17). All occurrences share the same concrete physical act of applying oil/ointment.
